violations.description: Missing lockfile with non-deterministic version ranges in package.json
violations.evidence: package-lock=false in .npmrc and package.json has caret version ranges (^26.6.3, ^7.0.0, etc.) without a committed lockfile (package-lock.json).
violations.recommendation: Remove package-lock=false from .npmrc, generate a package-lock.json, and commit it to ensure reproducible builds and dependency integrity.
